name: Tasks
description: Per-session task list. Plan multi-step work, mark progress as you go, the user sees a live TODO. Single Task tool with action switch (add, add_many, update, status, start, done, remove, reorder, list, clear). State lives at ~/.minimal-agent/sessions/<sid>.tasks.jsonl. Current task list is auto-injected into every user turn as <ma::agent::tasks>.

tool.name: Task
tool.description: Manage a per-session task list. Use at the start of any 3+ step plan (`add_many`) and mark each task `doing` before you work on it (`start`), `done` when finished (`done`). The user sees a live TODO with real-time status. Every action returns the post-mutation rendered list so you can confirm state. `id` accepts either a 1-indexed position (e.g. `3`) or a hash (`#a7b3c4`). Subtask hashes are parent + alpha suffix (`#a7b3c4a`).

id.description: Task reference. Accepts a six-hex hash (`a7b3c4`), an optionally-prefixed hash (`#a7b3c4`), a subtask hash (`a7b3c4a`), or a 1-indexed position integer (3). Required for: update, status, start, done, remove.

title.description: Task title (single line). Required for: add, update.

titles.description: Multiple task titles, created in order. Use for the initial plan dump at the start of a multi-step change. Required for: add_many.

parent.description: Make this task a subtask of the given parent. Accepts the same shapes as `id`. Optional for: add, add_many.

after.description: Insert the new task immediately after this task instead of at the end. Top-level only. Optional for: add.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded when setting status to canceled.

order.description: Top-level task ids in the desired new order. Subtasks ride along with their parent. Required for: reorder.

filter.description: Filter for `list` (currently advisory; full set is always rendered).

format.description: Result content format. `text` returns the rendered list; `json` returns a parseable shape suitable when you need to extract a specific field. `display` always renders ANSI text regardless.

parallel.description: For `start`: when true, skip auto-demoting sibling `doing` tasks. Default false (single-doing discipline).

force.description: For `clear`: override the refusal when any task is `doing`. Default false.
